title: Test Engineer - QA
jobDescription: Roles and Responsibilities: Demonstrated expertise in software testing across both web-based applications and desktop tools. Apply a design-focused approach to testing, ensuring alignment with functional requirements and user experience objectives. Analyze business and technical requirements to create comprehensive test scenarios that address all relevant use cases. Translate scenarios into detailed test cases and execute them across multiple environments, including development, QA, staging, and production. Prepare accurate, scenario-specific test data to support thorough validation and reliable outcomes. Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams to clarify requirements, optimize test coverage, and drive issue resolution. Additional Skills: Demonstrated hands-on expertise with leading design and modeling tools, including SolidWorks, Revit, Creo, Plant 3D, and Tekla. Strong proficiency and in-depth working knowledge of these software platforms. Skilled in translating complex business requirements into clear, structured test scenarios and test cases to ensure quality and accuracy.

title: IT Head
jobDescription: 15+ years of progressive IT experience, with a minimum of 5+ years in senior leadership roles, leading IT functions across, applications and service delivery in mid-scale organizations. Proven experience working in IT Consulting, IT Services, or IT Product Development organizations, with the ability to support both customer-facing delivery teams and internal business functions. Strong understanding of enterprise IT applications, including Microsoft ecosystem, exposure to full stack application development environments Solid hands-on and architectural understanding of modern integration platforms, cloud platforms, and enterprise systems, including legacy and hybrid environments such as AS400, ERPs, and third-party business applications. Ability to own and balance IT strategy with execution, cost optimization, operational efficiency, and reliability in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment. Act as a key enabler for delivery, product, and managed services teams by providing secure, scalable, and high-availability IT platforms, tools, and automation to improve time-to-market and service quality.

title: IT - System Admin
jobDescription: Monitored and analyzed real-time security alerts and logs using SIEM tools (Splunk, McAfee, QRadar) to identify threats and anomalies. Conducted Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT) across applications, networks, and cloud platforms. Implemented and maintained security solutions such as firewalls, EDR, DLP, IPS/IDS, patch management, and email security. Investigated and responded to security incidents and alerts, performing root cause analysis and recommending preventive actions. Maintained enterprise-wide compliance with ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA, and HITRUST CSF through continuous control monitoring and documentation. Supported audit processes by preparing evidence, reports, and gap assessments against regulatory frameworks. Performed internal security audits and supported risk assessments, business continuity, and disaster recovery planning. Collaborated with DevOps and cloud teams to integrate security controls into CI/CD pipelines and cloud services (AWS, Azure, O365). Enhanced organizational awareness by conducting security training, phishing simulations, and awareness campaigns. Developed and fine-tuned security policies, procedures, incident response plans, and risk registers.

title: Data Scientist
jobDescription: Analyze enterprise datasets (sales, marketing, trade promotion, pricing, inventory, media spend) to generate actionable insights. Build forecasting and time-series models (baseline and advanced) for demand, KPI trends, and scenario planning. Develop and evaluate marketing mix models (MMM) and incrementality frameworks where applicable. Create clear KPI definitions, metric layers, and semantic consistency across data sources and dashboards. Design experimentation/validation strategies, including back testing, holdout sets, and error decomposition. Translate analytical findings into stakeholder-ready narratives, visuals, and recommendations. Partner with data engineering to productionize feature creation, data validation rules, and scheduled refreshes. Develop PowerBI dashboards and/or curated reports that support self-serve decision making. Maintain documentation for assumptions, model limitations, and recommended usage patterns. Additional Skills: Python (pandas, statsmodels, scikit-learn), Prophet or equivalent SQL; notebook-based analysis workflows PowerBI; data modeling for BI (semantic layer/measure definitions) Azure / Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse/Warehouse) - preferred Version control (Git) and documentation practices Apply Now

title: AI Engineer(NLP)
jobDescription: Design and implement NLP solutions (classification, extraction, summarization, Q&A) aligned to product goals. Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines: indexing, chunking, embedding strategies, and reranking. Develop multimodal workflows when required (text + images/structured data) and define interfaces to downstream services. Fine-tune or adapt models (where appropriate) and establish evaluation datasets and metrics. Must have worked with MCP based architecture. Optimize inference for latency, throughput, and cost: batching, caching, quantization, and model selection strategies. Implement robust prompt and tool orchestration with guardrails, monitoring, and fallbacks. Collaborate with MLOps to productionize training/inference, including experiment tracking and model registry usage. Write clean, testable code; review PRs and mentor other engineers on ML best practices. Create technical docs for system design, model choices, and operational runbooks. Required Qualifications: Strong experience building NLP systems using PyTorch and Transformer-based architectures. Hands-on experience implementing RAG pipelines end-to-end (retrieval, reranking, generation, evaluation). Solid understanding of LLM behavior, prompting patterns, and failure modes (hallucination, tool misuse, leakage). Experience with Git-based development, Docker, and CI/CD practices for ML services. Working knowledge of relational and non-relational databases and how they fit into AI products. Ability to design APIs/inference services that are reliable and maintainable Preferred Qualifications Experience with multimodal models and document understanding pipelines. Experience with Kubernetes-based deployments and scaling strategies. Knowledge of Azure ML and cloud-native patterns for production AI systems. Experience with model distillation/quantization and serving optimization. Prior experience mentoring or leading a small technical workstream. Core Tools & Technologies: PyTorch, Transformers; optional TensorFlow familiarity RAG components: embeddings, vector stores, rerankers, eval harnesses Docker; CI/CD; Git Datastores: SQL + NoSQL; optional vector databases Kubernetes; Azure compute & services (where applicable)

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobDescription: Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and/or Azure DevOps for services, ML jobs, and IaC. Containerize applications and standardize base images, build caching, and vulnerability scanning workflows. Automate deployments across environments (dev/test/prod), including approvals and rollback strategies. Implement Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) modules and release pipelines (Terraform/Bicep). Manage secrets, certificates, and configuration across environments (Key Vault or equivalent). Set up logging, monitoring, and alerting; improve reliability through SLOs and runbooks. Optimize build and deployment time; enforce quality gates (tests, linting, security checks). Collaborate on networking and security hardening, including least-privilege access for pipelines. Support incident response and post-incident improvements for deployment and platform issues. Required Qualifications Strong experience with CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions and/or Azure DevOps) and release management. Hands-on experience with containerization (Docker) and managing deployments. Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform and/or Bicep) and environment automation. Good understanding of Linux, networking basics, and application observability. Experience with security best practices in build/deploy pipelines (secrets management, scanning, approvals). Ability to troubleshoot production issues across build, deploy, and runtime layers. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Kubernetes (AKS) and Helm-based deployments. Experience with policy-as-code and compliance controls (e.g., Azure Policy). Exposure to ML workloads in CI/CD (model packaging, artifact management, versioning). Experience with performance testing and load testing automation. Core Tools & Technologies GitHub Actions and/or Azure DevOps pipelines Docker; container registries; deployment automation Terraform and/or Bicep; environment provisioning Observability stack (logs/metrics/alerts), runbooks Azure platform services and security controls (Key Vault, RBAC)

title: Junior Scrum Master
jobDescription: Scrum & Agile Facilitation Facilitate all Scrum ceremonies including Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Planning, Sprint Review, and Retrospectives Ensure the team adheres to Agile/Scrum principles, values, and best practices Support one or more development teams in Agile execution Delivery Management Track sprint progress, velocity, and burndown charts Identify and remove impediments to improve team productivity Coordinate with Product Owners to refine and maintain the product backlog Ensure timely delivery of sprint goals and release commitments Team Collaboration & Coaching Foster an environment of transparency, communication, and continuous improvement Coach team members on Agile practices and self-organization Work closely with developers, testers, and cross-functional stakeholders Stakeholder Management Communicate sprint health, risks, and dependencies clearly to management Support Product Owners in defining sprint priorities Manage expectations across internal teams and external clients Process Improvement Drive continuous improvement initiatives across teams Implement metrics-based improvements to enhance delivery efficiency Promote Agile maturity within the team and organization Required Qualifications 3–4 years of experience as a Scrum Master in IT Services or Software Development Strong understanding of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) Experience using tools like Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, or Trello Good understanding of SDLC, QA processes, and DevOps concepts Excellent communication, facilitation, and conflict-resolution skills Ability to manage multiple teams or projects (nice to have) Additional Skills Preferred (Good to Have) Scrum Master certifications (CSM, PSM I/II) Exposure to distributed/offshore teams Basic technical understanding (APIs, cloud concepts, integration flows, etc.) Experience in client-facing roles

title: .Net
jobDescription: Design, develop, and maintain software modules in C#/.NET for CAD data exchange and automation. Implement and optimize data management workflows to ensure seamless interoperability between multiple CAD platforms. Collaborate with CAD domain experts and CAD API developers to build a robust library package and improve engineering productivity. Work on data translation, conversion, and validation processes across heterogeneous CAD applications. Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to CAD data exchange and workflow integration. Contribute to technical documentation, coding standards, and best practices. Stay updated with emerging .NET features, CAD interoperability standards and technologies. Required Skills Strong programming skills in C#/.NET (3-4 years’ experience) Experience with data management workflows (e.g., handling datasets, workflow automation, efficient data storage/retrieval, performance optimization). Familiarity with CAD automation domain (e.g., math basics, geometry basics, 3D/2D spatial understanding, capable to visualize concepts). Understanding of data interoperability concepts (file formats, schema mapping, data exchange standards). Problem solving mindset with ability to work on complex engineering workflows. Good communication and collaboration skills. Preferred Skills Knowledge of C++ for performance critical modules or CAD application integration. Exposure to CAD interoperability standards (BRep, Mesh, etc.).
